content_sections.heading: About BHU
content_sections.text: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) is in Varanasi. Its letterhead describes it as "an institution of national importance established by an Act of Parliament". Its Recruitment & Assessment Cell at Holkar House handles this recruitment, and the posts are in the Office of the Dean of Students.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Citizens are invited to apply. Eligibility, and every other criterion, is judged as on the last date for submitting the online application form, 26 November 2026. (a) Bachelor Degree in any Discipline from a recognized university/institute. (b) C level – Indian Sign Language Course or Diploma in Indian Sign Language Interpreter. (a) Minimum one year of Interpreting experience in an academic institute. (b) RCI Registration. These two items are listed as desirable, not essential. Candidates must be below 35 years. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHU Indian Sign Languages Interpreter
content_sections.text: Submit the online application form by 26 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Download the application form. Attach self-attested copies of your certificates and documents to the downloaded form. Submit the form and documents on or before 26 November 2026 to: Office of the Deputy Registrar, Recruitment & Assessment Cell, Holkar House, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi-221005. Check the University website, www.bhu.ac.in/rac, for updates on your eligibility status and the shortlist.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates will be shortlisted, and the shortlist will appear on www.bhu.ac.in/rac. Shortlisted candidates will be told the date and time of the interview by e-mail, well in advance. Bring your original certificates and mark-sheets to the interview for verification. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BHU Recruitment 2026 for Indian Sign Languages Interpreter?
faq.answer: There are 02 posts of Indian Sign Languages Interpreter, both in the UR category, in the Office of the Dean of Students, BHU. The University may increase or decrease the number of posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the BHU Indian Sign Languages Interpreter post?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 26 November 2026 at 5:00 PM. The downloaded application form, with self-attested documents, must be submitted to the Recruitment & Assessment Cell on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the BHU Indian Sign Languages Interpreter post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor Degree in any Discipline from a recognized university/institute. They also need a C level Indian Sign Language Course or a Diploma in Indian Sign Language Interpreter.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the BHU Indian Sign Languages Interpreter post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 35 years. Eligibility is judged as on 26 November 2026, the last date for the online application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the BHU Indian Sign Languages Interpreter?
faq.answer: The post pays fixed emoluments of Rs. 45,000/- p.m. (fixed).

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the BHU Indian Sign Languages Interpreter post?
faq.answer: Apply online by 26 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Then submit the downloaded application form, with self-attested certificates and documents, on or before 26 November 2026 to the Office of the Deputy Registrar, Recruitment & Assessment Cell, Holkar House, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi-221005.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the BHU Indian Sign Languages Interpreter post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview, and the date and time are sent to them by e-mail well in advance. They must bring original certificates and mark-sheets for verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BHU Indian Sign Languages Interpreter job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on contract basis for academic session 2026-2027, which may be extended, if required.

faq.question: Q9. Is RCI Registration required for the BHU Indian Sign Languages Interpreter post?
faq.answer: RCI Registration is a desirable qualification, not an essential one. The same applies to a minimum of one year of interpreting experience in an academic institute.

faq.question: Q10. Will BHU pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
